title: CBS Miami Spot on GTA6 Highlights 24-Year Shift in Media Attitude
description: A recent CBS Miami news spot on GTA6 has sparked discussions on Reddit, contrasting sharply with how media reacted 24 years before GTA: Vice City.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Fascinating Shift in Mainstream Media Attitude

Recently, a discussion caught the attention of the Reddit community over at r/GTA6. According to a post shared by user /u/Independent_Account2, CBS Miami recently broadcasted a short news spot focusing on *Grand Theft Auto VI*.

What makes this particular broadcast so interesting to the community is the stark contrast in how mainstream media views the franchise today compared to over two decades ago. Looking back 24 years ahead of the release of *GTA: Vice City*, the general media landscape and public tone surrounding the series were entirely different. Back then, television and press coverage often approached the controversial open-world franchise with skepticism or critical scrutiny. Seeing a mainstream outlet like CBS Miami report on *GTA6* with genuine excitement marks a remarkable cultural milestone.

## Community Reactions to Local Media Coverage

Given that Miami serves as the direct real-world inspiration for Vice City, local media coverage carries a unique weight for fans. The community discussion highlights how far the *GTA* series has come—evolving from a controversial video game franchise into an undeniable global pop-culture titan that even local news stations eagerly embrace.

At this stage, it is worth noting that this media spot is primarily a community-shared television segment rather than an official news drop or partnership announcement from Rockstar Games. It remains a fascinating cultural observation of how society perceives the upcoming title.

## Editor's Take

CBS Miami's enthusiastic spot on *GTA6* is more than just a fun local news segment; it is a testament to how far gaming culture has traveled. The journey from the cautious media climate surrounding *Vice City* two decades ago to today's open celebration of *GTA6* shows the undeniable impact of Rockstar's franchise on modern entertainment.
